account_admin_disable_description: They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you enable them again. Their recipes and history stay.
account_admin_create_hint: The person signs in with this login name and password, and can change the password afterwards.
account_admin_library: Add to a library you own
account_admin_invite_hint: The person creates their own account or joins with the one they have. Use Add user to set their password yourself.

account_admin_create_library_hint: You become its owner. Everyone else needs an invitation or a membership.
account_admin_recover_hint: Use this when a library has no active owner left. The change is recorded in audit history.
account_admin_recover_library_hint: An administrator is not a member of the library being recovered, so it is named by the identifier that appears in audit history.
account_admin_providers_lede: Map a provider's groups to library roles. Changes apply at each person's next sign-in.
account_admin_providers_none: No sign-in providers are configured on this instance.
account_admin_mapping_hint: Each rule owns its own grant. Manual memberships are kept.

integrations_scope_hint: Library owners manage recipe and household events. Instance administrators manage security events.

integrations_secret_hint: Copy this secret to your receiver now. It cannot be shown again. Enable delivery after your receiver is ready.
integrations_destination_hint: Use HTTPS. Private networks need explicit deployment configuration. HTTPS redirects are rechecked before delivery.
integrations_enable_hint: Paused subscriptions keep queued deliveries and ignore new events. Re-enabling resumes their queue.
integrations_repeated_failures: Paused after repeated failures; fix the receiver before enabling again.
integrations_queue_full: Paused because too many deliveries were waiting.
integrations_test_queued: Test queued. Refresh history to see the receiver’s response.
integrations_history_hint: Transient failures retry up to eight times within 24 hours. History keeps up to 1,000 finished deliveries for 30 days.
integrations_redelivery_queued: Redelivery queued with the same delivery ID.
integrations_api_hint: Use a personal API token with only the permissions and libraries your tool needs. Send it in the Authorization header. Read revisions before making changes.
integrations_example_hint: Set SAVORUM_URL, SAVORUM_TOKEN, and SAVORUM_LIBRARY in your shell. Replace the example recipe URL. This import creates a preview; review /api/v1/jobs/{id}/preview before posting an explicit policy to /api/v1/jobs/{id}/commit. Reuse an idempotency key only for an identical request within 24 hours.
integrations_signing_hint: Verify HMAC-SHA256 over the timestamp, a dot, and the exact request bytes using your signing secret. Compare in constant time, reject timestamps outside five minutes, and persist the signed delivery_id to prevent duplicate work. The Savorum-Signature header contains t=<timestamp>,v1=<hex signature>. A retry keeps its signed body and gets a fresh timestamp.
integrations_delete_hint: Pending deliveries will be cancelled and its signing secret retired.
integrations_rotate_hint: The old secret stops signing new attempts immediately. Pause delivery first if your receiver needs time to install the replacement. The new secret is shown once.
integrations_failing: Receiver failed {count} consecutive deliveries. Check history and send a test after fixing it.
integrations_delivery_network: The receiver could not be reached. Check its address, TLS certificate, and availability.
integrations_delivery_expired: The 24-hour retry window ended. Fix the receiver, then redeliver if this event is still useful.
integrations_delivery_key: The signing key is unavailable. Rotate the secret and install the replacement in your receiver.
integrations_delivery_destination: The destination was blocked by the instance network policy. Check its HTTPS address and trusted networks.
integrations_delivery_receiver: The receiver rejected this delivery. Check the HTTP status and response below.
integrations_delivery_redirect: The redirect was refused. Use the final allowed HTTPS address as the destination.
integrations_delivery_deleted: The subscription was removed and pending delivery was cancelled.
integrations_delivery_capacity: The delivery queue reached its limit. Fix the receiver before enabling the subscription again.
